description:
Read-only bulk security lookup via POST /v3/security-bulk. Paid only. Cost: 2 credits per valid IP. This MCP server accepts up to 250 IPs; private, bogon, and malformed IPs are not billed. Larger batches are rejected before any API call. Complete results are returned directly or as cached pages. Oversized results contain page.next_cursor for complete retrieval through get_cached_result without another API call or additional credits.

This endpoint is dedicated to security-only batches; bulk_lookup_ip with include=security provides security data together with geolocation or other IP domains. Returns one { ip, security } result per valid IP. fields/excludes accept security.* dot paths per item. force_refresh bypasses cached data, makes a new upstream request, and can consume credits.

excludes.description: Comma-separated dot-path fields to exclude per IP (e.g. security.is_tor,security.is_cloud_provider).

fields.description: Comma-separated dot-path fields to return per IP (e.g. security.threat_score,security.is_vpn). Reduces response size.

force_refresh.description: Default false. When true, bypasses cached bulk security data; a successful refresh makes a new upstream request and can consume credits.

ips.description: Array of IPv4 and/or IPv6 addresses to check. Minimum 1, maximum 250 in this MCP server.

name: bulk_security_check

error.description: Present when the whole tool call fails, with isError: true.

status.description: Present only when the API supplied an item HTTP status.

items.description: Present on success: complete API results in input order, including any per-item error messages.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned in page.cursor or page.next_cursor. Retrieval requires the same server process and API key and does not repeat the original lookup.

expires_at.description: ISO timestamp for idle expiry. Successful page reads extend the cache TTL; eviction or process restart can also remove the result.

json_fragment.description: JSON fragment of the original structuredContent. Fragments concatenate in offset order into the complete JSON, including bulk items and errors.

next_cursor.description: Cursor for the next get_cached_result page, absent on the last page. Page reads never call the API or consume credits.

title: Bulk Security Check
